products.name: Titanium Carabiner "Apex"
products.description: Aerospace-grade titanium carabiner with integrated bottle opener and glass breaker. Lightweight, indestructible, and essential for any tactical keychain setup.

products.name: Carbon Fiber Slim Wallet "Cipher"
products.description: Ultra-slim RFID blocking wallet made from real 3K carbon fiber and aerospace aluminum. Holds up to 12 cards without the bulk of a traditional wallet.
products.short_description: RFID blocking carbon fiber slim wallet.

products.name: Bolt Action Tactical Pen "Stinger"
products.description: Precision-machined bolt action pen. Features a tungsten steel glass breaker tip and aerospace aluminum body. compatible with Parker G2 refills.

products.name: Keychain Light "Lumen"
products.description: 650 lumens of blazing light in a package no bigger than your thumb. 4 lighting modes including tactical strobe. IPX8 waterproof rating.

products.name: Modular Key Organizer "Axis"
products.description: Quiet your keys and organize your life. The Axis holds 2-7 keys in a compact, jingle-free profile. Includes an integrated multi-tool.

products.name: Precision CNC Tweezers "Needle"
products.description: Titanium tweezers machined to a tolerance of 0.01mm. Perfect for precision work, removing splinters, or handling sensitive electronic components.

products.name: Multi-Tool Card "Void"
products.description: 20+ tools in the size of a credit card. Includes wrenches, drivers, openers, and measuring tools. Heat-treated stainless steel with matte black finish.

products.name: EDC Tech Pouch "Cell"

products.short_description: X-Pac tactical tech and cable organizer.

products.name: Aluminum Pry Bar "Lever"
products.description: Compact 7075-T6 aluminum pry bar. Save your pocket knife for cutting. Heavy-duty prying, scraping, and scoring tool.

products.name: Ceramic Folding Blade "Razor"
products.description: Non-metallic, non-corrosive zirconium oxide ceramic blade. Stays sharp 10x longer than steel. ultra-lightweight carbon fiber handle.
products.short_description: Zirconium ceramic blade with carbon fiber handle.

products.name: Magnetic Bit Driver Set "Torque"
products.description: Solid brass driver with ball-bearing swivel top. Includes 10 S2 steel micro bits in a tactical magnetic case. The ultimate desktop fidget and work tool.
